meta.description: Opens a garage door or gate from Home Assistant by sending the code of its own handset. An ESP32 board with a CC1101 transceiver records the handset once, then sends the same frames from a button in Home Assistant, from the board's own button, or from the Ramka. Works with fixed-code handsets only.

m5stack-module-cc1101.description: An M5Stack module with a CC1101 transceiver for 855 to 925 MHz, an SMA antenna and DIP switches that choose its pins; wired to the ESP32 board with eight jumpers.
m5stack-module-cc1101.does: Hears the handset's frames at 868 MHz during capture and sends them afterwards, so the board can open the gate.
